items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I think they've got Celestan and Paul Crawford's band. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah. Well, who's carrying on Celestan's band since Papa's past?

ctx.x: That's nice. You know, the Jazz Club is putting on a series of concerts. I think they've got Celestan and Paul Crawford's band. I got a postcard about it. I can't remember. They had a whole lineup of bands, a whole series of concerts. There's a little movement now to do a little something for it.
Oh, yeah. Well, who's carrying on Celestan's band since Papa's past?
